context: A uni student helps a teen friend work through hesitation
purpose: Teach: いつのまにか/とどめ/解り/なおさら/気付く/且つ/はかる/躊躇

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、面接の練習なんですけど…やっぱり躊躇しちゃって、なかなか言葉が出ないんです。
lines.en: Senpai, about the interview practice... I keep hesitating and the words just won't come out.
lines.style: Nervous teen seeking advice, voice trembles slightly with uncertainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。俺も最初そうだった。話すタイミングをはかるのって、意外と難しいんだよな。
lines.en: I get it. I was the same at first. Timing when to speak is surprisingly hard.
lines.style: Warm older student tone, reassuring and grounded, slightly casual delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 考えれば考えるほど、なおさら頭が真っ白になっちゃうんですよ…
lines.en: The more I think about it, the more my mind just goes completely blank...
lines.style: Frustrated teen sigh, voice dropping with self-conscious embarrassment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あのさ、いつのまにか自分にダメ出しばっかしてない?自分で気付くのって難しいけど、それ結構効くからな。
lines.en: Hey, haven't you been criticizing yourself without realizing? It's hard to notice on your own, but that really gets to you.
lines.style: Gentle but direct, voice softens with knowing empathy and care.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …あ、確かに。今ふっと気付くことができました。ずっと『またミスするかも』って思ってて…
lines.en: ...Oh, you're right. I just suddenly noticed it. I've been thinking 'I'll mess up again'...
lines.style: Quiet realization moment, voice slowing as she processes the truth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コツはシンプル且つ実践的でさ、最初の一言だけ決めとくの。それで流れができる。
lines.en: The trick is simple yet practical—just decide your opening line. The rest flows.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor energy, voice picks up with practical confidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど、解りやすい!心にとどめておきます。先輩のおかげで少し楽になりました。
lines.en: I see, that's easy to understand! I'll keep it in mind. I feel a bit lighter now.
lines.style: Brightening teen voice, relief and gratitude shining through her smile.
